title: macOS network debug, MITM proxy, firewall residual, and API client caches
description: Regenerable caches, logs, crash dumps, WebKit/HTTPStorages, and capture leftovers for network debugging proxies (Proxyman, Charles, HTTP Toolkit, mitmproxy, Fiddler Everywhere, Whistle), packet capture (Wireshark/tshark/tcpdump report-only for large captures), host firewall residual (Little Snitch, LuLu), VPN/proxy clients (Surge, ClashX, Clash Verge, V2rayU, Qv2ray, Outline, ShadowsocksX-NG), and API clients (Postman residual intercept, Insomnia residual, Paw/RapidAPI, HTTPie desktop, Bruno). Prefer contents-only deletes and age gates. Never wipe license files, MITM CA keys/certs, or proxy rule/profile configs by default.

risk_policy.session_recordings_flows: medium (may hold request bodies/secrets; off by default)
risk_policy.mitm_ca_certs_keys: never-touch / exclude (reinstall breaks HTTPS intercept until re-trusted)
risk_policy.proxy_profiles_rules_subscriptions: report-only or medium (user config, not pure junk)
risk_policy.firewall_rules_config: report-only residual inventory only (do not auto-wipe live rules)
risk_policy.already_covered: Postman/Insomnia primary Electron Cache/Code Cache/GPUCache/logs appear in apps-comms and office-electron; this batch adds intercept/agent residual and adjacent trees only

notes: Sources: Homebrew cask zap stanzas (proxyman, charles, http-toolkit, wireshark-app, little-snitch, lulu, surge, clash-verge-rev, v2rayu, shadowsocksx-ng, outline-manager, bruno, httpie-desktop, rapidapi), Proxyman/mitmproxy/Whistle/Fiddler docs, Objective Development Little Snitch uninstall docs. System /Library paths and privileged helpers are out of default user clean (never-touch / root). Certificates live in Keychain after install; on-disk PEM/P12 under app support must not be bulk-deleted. path_count is total path template strings across rules.

rules.name: Proxyman caches and HTTP/WebKit storage
rules.description: Proxyman regenerable caches, crash reporter data, HTTPStorages, WebKit site data. Not CA or user-data.
rules.notes: Do not delete Application Support app-data certs (proxyman-ca.pem) or user-data/session DB. Close Proxyman first.

rules.name: Proxyman logs and saved state
rules.description: Proxyman resume state and any Logs under Proxyman support trees.
rules.notes: Saved Application State is regenerable window restore only.

rules.name: Proxyman Application Support inventory (report-only)
rules.description: Full Proxyman support trees including user-data, backups, and CA material. Inventory only.
rules.notes: CA at .../app-data/proxyman-ca.pem; user-data and user-data-backups hold request history and Map Local. Never bulk wipe. License/activation may also live under Preferences (excluded from delete rules).

rules.name: Charles Proxy caches and support sessions
rules.description: Charles Application Support session/recording cache side data. Config/license stays out of default clean.
rules.notes: Charles stores large .chls sessions under Application Support. Medium risk: may contain auth headers/bodies. Never delete ~/Library/Preferences/com.xk72.charles.config (settings/license).

rules.name: Charles saved state and residual logs
rules.description: Charles window restore and log leftovers.
rules.notes: Safe regenerable UI state/caches. Preferences/config not listed.

rules.name: HTTP Toolkit caches and logs
rules.description: HTTP Toolkit Electron/server caches, logs, and browser-detect preference cache.
rules.notes: Preferences/httptoolkit holds browsers.json detect cache (safe). Do not wipe whole Application Support root if it stores API mocks/collections the user relies on; prefer listed subdirs. MITM CA is managed separately; never bulk-delete cert stores.

rules.name: HTTP Toolkit Application Support root (report-only)
rules.description: Full HTTP Toolkit support tree for size inventory.
rules.notes: Report sizes; clean only known cache/log children via net-httptoolkit-caches-logs.

rules.name: mitmproxy flow dumps and temp (careful)
rules.description: Aged flow files and temp under ~/.mitmproxy excluding CA keys.
rules.notes: NEVER delete mitmproxy-ca.pem, mitmproxy-ca-cert.pem, mitmproxy-ca-cert.p12, or dhparam. Deleting CA forces re-trust everywhere. Flows may contain secrets (medium).

rules.name: mitmproxy CA and config inventory (report-only)
rules.description: Report size of mitmproxy home including certs; never auto-delete.
rules.notes: Default confdir ~/.mitmproxy (docs.mitmproxy.org). config.yaml + CA material. Report-only always.

rules.name: Wireshark caches and HTTP/WebKit storage
rules.description: Wireshark app caches, cookies store, HTTPStorages, WebKit. Not profiles or captures.
rules.notes: Personal config/profiles live under ~/.config/wireshark (report-only sibling). Captures are separate.

rules.name: Wireshark personal config and profiles (report-only)
rules.description: Wireshark personal configuration, colorfilters, profiles. Inventory only.
rules.notes: Profiles and recent files lists. Not junk. System ChmodBPF under /Library is out of user clean scope.

rules.name: Packet captures pcap/pcapng (report-only large)
rules.description: Large tcpdump/tshark/Wireshark capture files under common user-writable temps. Report-only; never auto-delete captures.
rules.notes: Captures are often intentional evidence. Documents/Desktop/Downloads are never-touch for bulk clean; engine must still refuse those roots. Prefer report size + age; user deletes explicitly. tshark/tcpdump have no large fixed cache root beyond output paths.

rules.name: Little Snitch residual caches and logs
rules.description: User-scoped Little Snitch caches and agent logs after install/uninstall residual.
rules.notes: Caches/logs only. Rules and configuration must not be wiped as part of space reclaim (see report-only residual rule). System /Library/Application Support/Objective Development is root-owned and out of default scope.

rules.name: Little Snitch configuration residual (report-only)
rules.description: Little Snitch Application Support and rule-related prefs inventory after uninstall or for size.
rules.notes: Live firewall rules. Uninstaller intentionally keeps config so reinstall restores rules. Never auto-delete. Preferences plists under ~/Library/Preferences/at.obdev.* hold settings; leave them.

rules.name: LuLu residual caches
rules.description: Objective-See LuLu firewall caches left after use or uninstall.
rules.notes: Rules live in Preferences (com.objective-see.lulu*.plist) and must not be default-cleaned. Residual caches only.

rules.name: LuLu rules and preferences residual (report-only)
rules.description: LuLu preference/rules residual inventory only.
rules.notes: Firewall allow/block rules. Report-only residual after uninstall.

rules.name: Surge caches, logs, and HTTP storage
rules.description: Surge Mac regenerable caches, Bugsnag crumbs, logs, HTTPStorages. Not profiles or license.
rules.notes: Profiles, modules, and license under Application Support/Surge or com.nssurge.surge-mac are not default-deleted.

rules.name: Surge profiles and Application Support (report-only)
rules.description: Surge profiles, database, and license-related support trees.
rules.notes: User profiles, rule sets, MITM CA, and paid license state. Report-only.

rules.name: ClashX / ClashX Pro caches and logs
rules.description: ClashX menu-bar client caches and logs. Config/subscriptions separate.
rules.notes: Do not wipe config.yaml / subscriptions under Application Support or ~/.config/clash without user intent.

rules.name: ClashX config and profiles (report-only)
rules.description: ClashX Application Support and classic clash config home.
rules.notes: Proxy providers, MMDB GeoIP databases, and subscription caches. MMDB can be large but is config-adjacent; report-only.

rules.name: Clash Verge / Verge Rev caches
rules.description: Clash Verge (Tauri) and Clash Verge Rev caches and WebKit data.
rules.notes: Profiles under Application Support stay; only caches/logs/WebKit.

rules.name: Clash Verge profiles and support (report-only)
rules.description: Clash Verge Rev support tree with profiles, clash core logs, and geo data.
rules.notes: Subscriptions, profiles, Country.mmdb, geoip. Report-only; user may prune logs/ subdir manually.

rules.name: V2rayU caches and logs
rules.description: V2rayU caches, HTTPStorages, and log file.
rules.notes: Server list and preference under Application Support / ~/.V2rayU are not default-cleaned.

rules.name: V2rayU config residual (report-only)
rules.description: V2rayU home and Application Support including cores and configs.
rules.notes: Pac, conf, v2ray-core binaries copies. Report-only.

rules.name: Qv2ray caches and logs
rules.description: Qv2ray (deprecated GUI) caches and logs.
rules.notes: Config connections under ~/.config/qv2ray are report-only sibling.

rules.name: Qv2ray config residual (report-only)
rules.description: Qv2ray config home and Application Support residual after uninstall.
rules.notes: Connection groups and plugin data. Project is deprecated; residual cleanup is user-driven.

rules.name: Outline Manager Electron caches and logs
rules.description: Outline Manager (server admin) Electron caches and logs. Not access keys.
rules.notes: Do not wipe Local Storage session that may hold server management tokens without user intent; prefer listed cache/log children.

rules.name: Outline Client caches and logs
rules.description: Outline VPN client caches/logs (App Store / Cordova layouts).
rules.notes: Access keys and server configs are user data. Container Group Containers may hold VPN state; not listed for default delete. Note: unrelated 'Outline' notes app also uses Library/Logs/Outline paths; age/name filters reduce collateral.

rules.name: ShadowsocksX-NG caches
rules.description: ShadowsocksX-NG caches. Config under .ShadowsocksX-NG is separate.
rules.notes: Server list and local socks config must not be wiped by default.

rules.name: ShadowsocksX-NG config residual (report-only)
rules.description: ShadowsocksX-NG home and Application Support residual.
rules.notes: ss-local conf, privoxy, kcp. Report-only residual.

rules.name: Whistle proxy logs and cache data
rules.description: Whistle Node proxy crash log and cache under .WhistleAppData excluding certs/rules.
rules.notes: whistle.log path documented in FAQ. Never wipe certs/ or custom rules/values. Capture storage may hold bodies (medium).

rules.name: Whistle client Electron caches
rules.description: Desktop Whistle client (whistle-client) Electron caches if installed.
rules.notes: Optional GUI wrapper paths; CLI-only installs may only have ~/.WhistleAppData.

rules.name: Fiddler Everywhere caches and logs
rules.description: Fiddler Everywhere Electron caches and Logs folder. License excluded.
rules.notes: License lives at ~/Library/Application Support/Fiddler Everywhere/License (docs). Never wipe. Captured sessions may sit under Application Support root (report sibling).

rules.name: Fiddler Everywhere full support (report-only)
rules.description: Full Fiddler Everywhere tree including AutoSave/sessions and license.
rules.notes: May include AutoSave traffic archives and License/. Report-only.

rules.name: Postman intercept/agent residual
rules.description: Postman Interceptor/proxy agent residual beyond primary Electron caches already in apps-comms.
rules.notes: Primary Cache/Code Cache/GPUCache/logs already covered elsewhere; this rule is residual intercept/agent/storage. Never delete Postman_Config, IndexedDB collections, or storage/ of collections. Close Postman first.

rules.name: Insomnia residual caches beyond primary
rules.description: Insomnia Service Worker, Session Storage, HTTPStorages residual beyond primary electron caches.
rules.notes: Leaves insomnia*.db request collections. Primary Cache/GPUCache covered in apps-comms.

rules.name: Paw / RapidAPI caches and container caches
rules.description: Paw (now RapidAPI) container caches and logs. Not project documents.
rules.notes: Paw documents (.paw) are user projects (never-touch if under Documents). Container Application Support may hold cloud tokens; stick to Caches/Logs/tmp.

rules.name: Paw/RapidAPI container residual (report-only)
rules.description: Full Paw container and Application Scripts residual inventory.
rules.notes: Sandbox container; may include local API libraries. Report-only.

rules.name: HTTPie desktop caches and logs
rules.description: HTTPie for Desktop Electron caches and logs.
rules.notes: Collections/sessions under Application Support/HTTPie root are user data; prefer listed subdirs only.

rules.name: Bruno API client caches
rules.description: Bruno Electron caches and logs. Collections are git-friendly files outside this tree.
rules.notes: Bruno collections live in user-chosen project folders (never auto-scan Documents). App Support holds window state and cache only for space reclaim.

rules.name: Proxy MITM certs and licenses inventory (report-only never-wipe)
rules.description: Explicit report-only list of known CA/license locations so cleaners do not target them.
rules.notes: HARD POLICY: never default-clean MITM private keys, trusted CA PEMs, or paid license blobs. Re-trust cost is high. Keychain entries are outside path cleaners entirely.
